scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid Pebble being left without reliable overnight food while a long shift overlaps a feeder-reset hazard.
Emerging Need: A broad device advisory is only background until an extended absence and scheduled electrical transfer make the affected feeder likely to be used unattended.
Decision Context: Observable updates establish the absence, reset timing, and brief neighbor-access window; the saved pet note contains the feeder serial, backup-feeding instruction, access detail, and no-paid-sitter preference.
Consequence: Timely attention can preserve a no-cost backup before access disappears; afterward, the same preparation cannot prevent the unattended feeding gap.

parameter.subject: PF-Mini feeder latch advisory for select 2026 batches
parameter.body: Purrfect Portions has identified a latch-sensor issue in a limited group of PF-Mini feeders. Affected units can miss a scheduled dispense after an AC power interruption or smart-plug reset. If an affected feeder will be used unattended before the free latch kit arrives, use a backup feeding plan. The affected serial range is PF26-A1400 through PF26-A1499; compare the recorded device label before requesting a kit.
